children: Binance Wallet announced on X that the Club Atlético de Madrid vs. Real Madrid CF prediction market is now live. The announcement highlighted the Madrid derby matchup between the two clubs and said the market is available for users to participate in. It also noted that the event is tied to a PnL Trading Competition with a total prize pool of 100,000 USDT. No additional details were provided in the post about the competition format, eligibility, or timing. The announcement focused on the live status of the prediction market and the prize pool available for participants.

The post described the matchup as a contest between two sides of the same city and framed the prediction market around the derby result. It did not include further information about how users can enter, how prizes will be distributed, or whether there are any specific rules beyond the competition itself. The only numerical detail given was the 100,000 USDT prize pool. The announcement did not mention any other teams, markets, or related events.

title: Binance Wallet Launches Madrid Derby Prediction Market and 100,000 USDT PnL Trading Competition
